name: SciCode-Runnable-Benchmark-Reviewed
description: A curated set of runnable programming problems drawn from the SciCodePile, designed to measure a model's ability to generate correct, executable code. Tasks are evaluated by running produced programs against reference tests to determine functional correctness. The benchmark emphasizes real-world coding behavior (compilation, I/O, and edge cases) rather than just matching reference text.
reputation: A niche but useful runnable-code benchmark used by researchers focusing on execution-based evaluation of code models; not as widely cited as CodeXGLUE or HumanEval.
